introduction_to_magic_101.name: Introduction to Magic 101
introduction_to_magic_101.description: Core battle flow, basic summoning, and basic spellcasting.

ui_showcase.name: Academy Orientation — UI Showcase
ui_showcase.description: A temporary guided tour of the current interface, campus, battle, progression, and reward flows.

ui_showcase.offer_1: Before we begin formal lessons, I want you to learn where the Academy keeps the tools every summoner relies on.
ui_showcase.offer_2: Review your records and equipment, prepare your spellbook, visit the campus services, and then meet me at the practice grounds.
ui_showcase.accept_response: Show me around. I am ready to begin the orientation.
ui_showcase.accepted: Start with your Journal. Its tracked assignment will guide you through each stop.
ui_showcase.turn_in: Good. You have seen the full rhythm: prepare, fight, grow, and return. The rest of the Academy can wait for another day.

introduction_to_magic.offer_1: You do not need to know what kind of summoner you are yet. That is what your first year is for.
introduction_to_magic.offer_2: Let us begin somewhere simple. Call a creature, keep it under control, and show me how you respond when the field changes.
introduction_to_magic.accept_response: I am ready. I will commit part of my first-year curriculum capacity to this.
introduction_to_magic.accepted: Good. Take your time, and pay attention to what the creature needs from you.
introduction_to_magic.summon_practice_reminder: There is no rush. The practice grounds are ready when you are—focus on keeping control of the creature you summon.
introduction_to_magic.turn_in: You kept your focus when the exercise pushed back. That matters more than making it look effortless.

foundation_focus.offer_1: You have the beginning of control. Now you need to decide where to place your attention.
foundation_focus.offer_2: You may study how to bind creatures more deliberately, or focus on shaping spells under pressure. You cannot commit to both paths this term.

summoning_basics.accept_response: I want to understand the creatures I summon—and how to keep control of them.
summoning_basics.accepted: Then begin at the practice grounds. Control matters more than calling something impressive.
summoning_basics.turn_in: You treated the creature as something to understand, not merely a weapon. Continue that way.

practical_spellcraft.accept_response: I want to learn how to shape spells when the field is fighting back.
practical_spellcraft.accepted: Then take your working deck to the practice grounds. Precision first; power follows.
practical_spellcraft.turn_in: Your spellwork held together under pressure. That discipline will carry into every element.

charge_intro.speaker: Merlin
charge_intro.line_1: A wild slime blocks your path. This one looks... different. Tougher.

charge_tanky_slime.speaker: Merlin
charge_tanky_slime.line_1: By the stones! This slime's hide is incredibly thick. Your units' attacks barely scratch it!

charge_explain.speaker: Merlin
charge_explain.line_1: Use your Charge card! Command a unit to rush past the slime to the enemy core. Sometimes victory isn't about fighting—it's about strategy.

merlin_summoner_intro.speaker: Merlin
merlin_summoner_intro.line_1: The time has come, Initiate. Step into the circle.
merlin_summoner_intro.line_2: Each summoner brings an elemental nature already their own.
merlin_summoner_intro.line_3: Choose your path wisely... though fate does favor the bold.

first_trial_intro.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_intro.line_1: Welcome to the training grounds, Initiate.
first_trial_intro.line_2: Your affinity was always yours. Now we put theory into practice.
first_trial_intro.line_3: Before you lies a simple trial. A single slime awaits beyond.
first_trial_intro.line_4: Show me you understand the fundamentals. Victory here earns your place among the Academy's summoners.

first_trial_card_explain.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_card_explain.line_1: These cards summon units to defend your base.
first_trial_card_explain.line_2: Each shows its mana cost, attack, and health.
first_trial_card_explain.line_3: You start with 10 mana—enough for several summons.

first_trial_core_explain.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_core_explain.line_2: Beat them before they reach your base. Destroy their core to win!

first_trial_enemy_appears.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_enemy_appears.line_2: If it reaches your base, you'll take damage.

first_trial_play_prompt.speaker: Headmaster Merlin
first_trial_play_prompt.line_1: You try—play a card to defend!
first_trial_play_prompt.line_2: Drag it onto the battlefield to summon your unit.

simple_greeting.speaker: Friendly Wizard
simple_greeting.line_2: Welcome to the world of card battles.
simple_greeting.line_3: May your deck be strong and your mana plentiful!

chain_start.speaker: Old Sage
chain_start.line_1: This is the beginning of a longer story...
chain_start.line_2: It will continue in the next dialogue.

chain_end.speaker: Old Sage
chain_end.line_1: And here we are at the conclusion.
chain_end.line_2: Dialogue chains allow for multi-part conversations!
chain_end.line_3: This is very useful for storytelling.
